paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.05% on average, with Nasdaq strongest (+0.05%) and Hang Seng weakest (-3.03%). Brent crude changed -1.62% to 111.34. Gold changed -1.10% to 4,015.6001. Bitcoin changed +0.41% to 81,646.3906. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.988%, a relative move of +0.71%. Among the firms tracked, Equinor (+5.06%) and ConocoPhillips (+4.08%) moved the most.
